THE LITANY ENGINE
Crypt · Religious Horror, Gothic · sedlec-ossuary

PREMISE
Every chamber seems arranged to continue a prayer that no living voice remembers.

READ-ALOUD
No read-aloud text assigned yet.

ROOM KEY
Map Room 1 — 01 Skull Lined Corridor | Role: entrance | Premise: Every chamber seems arranged to continue a prayer that no living voice remembers. | Sensory: cold incense · The room tastes dry and mineral, as if each breath scrapes through old bone dust. · Small clicks travel through the bonework, like teeth settling after speech. | Feature: bone chandeliers | Danger: A sermon text is carved into a floor slab polished by knees and footsteps. | Components: Environmental Hazard: Weight-Sermon Slab; Disturbing Clue: Miscounted Skull Row; Encounter Twist: Bonework Cover Lines; Location Premise: Litany Engine Ossuary; Sensory Layer: Bone-Dust Breath; Sensory Layer: Clicking Skull Seams
